messages:
rajesh: Quick follow-up from the RFC readthrough  we need a compact plan that preserves SLA-critical observability while cutting long-tail cost. Proposal: "telemetry slimming" with SLA-tiered windows + on-demand rehydrate. Short check?

emily: Sounds useful. how do SLA tiers map to capture fidelity?

rajesh: Tiers: GOLD (full spans for 1h sliding), SILVER (full for 5m then compact), BRONZE (compact immediately). Compact envelopes include route_id, span_count, billing_hash, tenant_hint, provenance_token, minimal histogram sketch. Keep a tiny reservoir of full traces per route for calibration.

tereza: Rehydrate path? synchronous vs async? latency targets?

rajesh: Two modes: sync rehydrate on query (best-effort, target p95 < 2s for GOLD/SILVER; <5s for BRONZE), and async background rehydrate for recent problem investigations. Rehydrate uses provenance_token to fetch raw objects from cold archive; reservoir helps speed common cases.

matt: Billing joins: hashed billing_key causes fuzzy joins. how do we give teams confidence?

rajesh: We'll publish per-aggregation "attr_confidence" derived from reservoir calibration and expose it in billing exports + Console. For enterprise customers that need exact joins, offer opt-in full-billing-key retention behind KMS. Default: hashed with confidence band.

emily: Rollout and rollback? we need short feedback loops.

rajesh: Canary by percent of routes via feature-flag. Metrics to watch: telemetry_unit_cost, route_query_tail_latency (for rehydrate), billing_attr_mismatch_rate. Guard conditions: if mismatch_rate > 0.01 or rehydrate_p95 rises > 20%, auto-step-down aggressiveness or flip affected tenants to GOLD. CLI: POST /ops/flags?name=telemetry_slimming&percent=1

tereza: Testing plan? dry-run that marks traces but ingests full payloads?

rajesh: Exactly. Dry-run mode: sidecar tags would-be cohorts but we still store full traces; offline simulator replays weeks of data and outputs per-route: cost_delta_pct, attr_confidence_delta, alert_breakage_index. We keep a small deterministic sample (1/10k) of full traces even in compact mode for sanity checks.

matt: Console UX: show route tier, attr_confidence, sample_rate, expected_cost_savings. Also a "Request full window" button to temporarily move route to GOLD for N hours. Add audit trail.

emily: Ops: implement sidecar for controlled rollouts (less SDK churn). prefer sidecar over pushing logic into many SDKs.

ops-bot: Created task OBS-5001: "telemetry-slimming SLA-tier follow-up" with subtasks: schema_compact_envelope, sidecar_poc, dry-run_sim, console_mocks, canary_playbook.

tereza: One more edge-case: if provenance tokens point to missing objects (edge crash) we must mark "partial_forensic" and fallback to reservoir extrapolation. Include that in runbook.

rajesh: Good catch. We'll add that and include a fast forensic restore API for tenant disputes that triggers rehydrate + reconciliation CSV. Also add rate-limits to avoid thundering-herd.

emily: I'll run the dry-run job and share deltas next week. teresa will prototype Console widgets. matt will draft rollback automation.

matt: I'll also add alerts and an auto-mitigation webhook that flips tenant to GOLD for 24h on severe mismatch.

ops-bot: Reminder: obs-arch sync Thu 10:00  add this item to agenda? (yes/no)

rajesh: yes please.

emily: thanks everyone  concise and actionable.
